caption: The drawing depicts a round, shallow plate or bowl with a decorative floral pattern. The central motif features a large, symmetrical flower with eight petals rendered in shades of brown and orange. Surrounding this central flower are two smaller, similarly colored flowers on either side and a pair of stylized tulip-like blooms arching upwards. The floral designs are outlined in dark brown and filled with gradients of reddish-brown and orange, with green accents interspersed along the background of the plate. The edge of the plate is bordered with a repeating scalloped or beaded pattern in darker brown. The background color of the plate is a muted beige or tan with green and brown splotches. The drawing is centered on a plain off-white or cream-colored background. At the bottom right of the image, the name "CHARLOTTE ANGUS" is written in small, uppercase, red letters.
title: Plate
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
